verdict.rationale: Mercury provides a documented public REST API covering transactions, invoices, categories, statements, webhooks, and OAuth2 authorization, plus an llms.txt/OpenAPI markdown index explicitly for AI agents, and an official CLI (verified via probe) built on the same API. This is strong first-party and probe-corroborated evidence of a documented, programmable public API for AI-native use. missing for 10: independent third-party developer accounts of building against the API beyond the official CLI probe.
